instruction: Make the red suite green without weakening its assertions: in src/lib/site.server.ts, publicClient() must throw an error matching /Missing Supabase environment/ when SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, VITE_SUPABASE_URL, and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY are all empty (never construct a client against placeholder URLs/keys), while still using runtime process.env when present and letting publicPlans() fail soft to default plans. Run the verifier; all 3 tests in src/lib/site.server.test.ts must pass, and no test assertion may be edited to get green.
title: Fix site.server publicClient missing-env guard
